mapping.draft_py:
# Fleeting Flight: "Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying until end of turn.
# Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn."
# Sentence 1: B5b-put-counter (Feat of Resistance's "on target creature you control") without
# "you control". Sentence 2: B5b-it-gains-kw-eot (Basri Ket's "It gains indestructible until end of
# turn", the result register: the creature the counter went on) with FLYING. Sentence 3: Pack
# Leader's PREVENT_EFFECT of combat damage this turn, scoped to "it", the spell's target, as M21
# Frost Breath's "those creatures" (IS_ANY_TARGET on the condition and on the event's filter).
counter = A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
    'count': QConst(value=1),
    'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
    'target': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
})
flying = A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
    'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
    'duration': DurationEot(),
    'target': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAnd(children=()),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        referent='result',
    ),
})
prevent = A(Verb.PREVENT_EFFECT, {
    'condition': FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET),
    'duration': DurationEot(),
    'event': DamageDealtEvent(
        amount=QUnbounded(),
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET),
        combat=True,
    ),
})
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.INSTANT, effect=Seq(steps=(counter, flying, prevent)))]

clauses.clause: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
It gains flying until end of turn.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.

mapping.notes: PUT_COUNTER on target creature; 'It gains flying' on the result register (B5b-it-gains-kw-eot); 'Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn' is Pack Leader's PREVENT_EFFECT (combat damage, until end of turn) scoped to the target as Frost Breath's (IS_ANY_TARGET on the condition and the event filter). G1 does not show the prevention. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/fleeting_flight_*.json (blocked by a 4/4 it takes nothing and deals 3; an untargeted attacker dies; noncombat damage still kills it; gone next turn).

clauses.clause: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
clauses.evidence: [cast targets=...] for all six creatures (the menu is every creature): 'you_bear gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 counter(s) (by card/PUT_COUNTER)', 'counters {} -> {PLUS_1_PLUS_1: 1}; P/T 2/2 -> 3/3' (likewise you_giant 5/5, opp_flier 2/2, opp_tapped 4/4, opp_bear 3/3, opp_giant 5/5); the counter stays 'after the turn ends' (no P/T change then): one counter, on the target only.

clauses.clause: It gains flying until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: 'you_bear: ... keywords +FLYING' then 'after the turn ends: you_bear: keywords -FLYING' (the same for you_giant, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant); opp_flier already has printed flying: no keyword change and nothing removed at end of turn, correct. Pack A11_5 attacks with it: the ground creature is never offered a block.

clauses.clause: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.
clauses.evidence: The probe has no combat in any cast variant, so the prevention is never tested. Covered by packs: A11_1 (the blocker's 5 combat damage to the target is prevented, the target survives with no damage and deals its 3), A11_2 (non-combat damage is not prevented), A11_3 (only the target is protected: its fellow attacker takes 4 and dies), A11_4 (on the next turn combat damage kills it).
